name: Integrated Information Theory (IIT)
title: Integrated Information Theory (IIT) — Cognitive-layer theoretical reference
description: Curated reference for Integrated Information Theory (Tononi 2004-2023, IIT 1.0 through 4.0). Consciousness is identified with Φ, the irreducible cause-effect power of a system over itself from its own intrinsic perspective. Includes the five axioms, postulates, Φ formalism, qualia space, empirical predictions (PCI, posterior hot zone), COGITATE adversarial test, major critiques (Aaronson, Doerig unfolding argument, 2023 pseudoscience letter), and bridge to EFC/CEM.

originator.name: Giulio Tononi
originator.affiliation: Wisconsin Institute for Sleep and Consciousness, University of Wisconsin–Madison

key_equation.name: System integrated information
key_equation.description: Φ is the distance (intrinsic difference / Wasserstein / KL) between the system's cause-effect structure and its minimum-information partition; the locally maximum-Φ complex (Φ_max) identifies the conscious entity by the exclusion postulate.

empirical_signatures: PCI distinguishing wakefulness, NREM, REM, anaesthesia
